reviews.text:
This was my first time visiting the Brooklyn chophouse. Ambience was a 10 out of a 10. It was set up perfectly for Valentines night. The prefix menu was pretty good. 175 a person it wasn’t bad. I did however order three  love potion drinks they were $25 apiece zero buzz for three drinks for that cost. service was very good. The servers were attentive. We had the salt and pepper lobster which was very good we had the filet mignon, which was very very good. We had a side of mashed potatoes. We had the crab fried rice that was very good. We had the chicken satay. I would give it a seven out of 10. My only complaint would Be that the seating was very close. The first couple we sat next to they were very friendly that we engaged them it was valentine so of course it’s awkward sitting next to people while you’re having a dinner, but then when they left the couple that sat down was a little bit more obnoxious a little louder so my advice would just be for something intimate like that kind of maybe not put people so on top of each other but other than that, I would definitely go back again .￼ The desert was huge and definitely a cute touch. Prosecco was included however we never received it. No biggie
Cute experience overall .

reviews.text: Great very expensive for Valentine’s Day but great

Went here fist time and I would not go back.  It was Valentine’s Day menu which I knew going in but the food was tasteless with a few items such as mashed potatoes and broccoli being decent.  The steak was cooked to correct temp surprisingly but had no taste (I wouldn’t offer filet mignon as the only steak option on the menu). My wife’s lamb chops were ok.  Drinks were watered down and we were supposed to get prosecco at the end which we had to ask for and the waiter said “oh you want it”.  Why wouldn’t you ask first before making an assumption someone wouldn’t want everything that they are paying for on the menu.  Anyway, I don’t expect pre-fixed menus to be amazing but I was turned off by the taste, watered down drinks, and bill was served without request before we even got our prosecco which I always find rude in any restaurant.
Definitely recommend everything was a plus food drinks service good vibes good music

reviews.text:
My nephew came to town to visit and thought it would be nice to go to a steak house. I had heard good things about Brooklyn Chop House and made a reservation. Unfortunately, an excellent steak was ruined by some of the worst service I have ever received at a restaurant in the city.

First the good: the steak itself (the ribeye) was fantastic, if slightly smaller than advertised on the menu. Cooked to perfection and flavorful. The sides were good if not to the level of the steak.

The bad: Our service was so bad that it felt intentional. We arrive and immediately get an eye roll from our server, Alex, and he also immediately takes away the wine list (funny enough after my nephew and I were discussing our favorite wines). We order our cocktails, steak and two sides, the bok choy and mac and cheese. When the sides arrive, they bring us bok choy and mashed potatoes. No issue, sometimes there are mix-ups so I tell the person who brought our food out about the mix-up that we had ordered the mac and cheese. Alex, then says "You don't want the mashed potatoes, now." No, we would just like what we original ordered.

After we eat our dinner we order dessert, a scoop of ice cream for each of us and a glass of wine. Before we are even able to order he says "I have a nice Moscato for you." We end up getting two glasses of Malbec and our ice cream is brought out in a single bowl even though we asked for them separately.
Finally, our sever immediately gives us the check and within one minute is already asking if we are ready to pay. We had not even finished our dessert or wine yet. There were several tables that had arrived before us and left after we did who did not get that level of push to leave, let alone the disdain we experienced during the entire meal.

Overall, what should have been a fun time with my nephew was marred by a terrible server. I hope that other patrons like us don't receive that level of treatment.

reviews.text:
This is a very beautiful establishment with great food. There's someone that comes around and takes photos for $27 and you get a framed photo + the all digitals for "free" (I believe). We ordered the Caesar salad, sweet and sour chicken and the chicken fried rice for 2.

My con for this restaurant was the service and seating. They are squeezing a bunch of people into a small space. We were so close to the tables next to us that we could hear every part of their conversations. As for the service...from the moment we entered although sat instantly we were not greeted by the host staff. Our server was kind but non-attentive. When ordering your food you have to order everything at one time. This includes, small plates, entrees, sides and whatever other food you want. We waited so long on our server to come back to our table that we ended up with our meal before being able to get a straw for our water. She never came back to see if we wanted to order a drink or even if we wanted to order more food. Overall, it was a great meal but disappointing customer service experience for a birthday dinner. We made note to the manager about our experience and accepted this wasn't the experience we were hoping for on our last night in NYC.

Something to note: They do offer a slice of cheesecake if you're celebrating something.
We had lovely service & great food! Our waiter was extremely helpful and friendly. Will be back
